technicalInterruptions.description: Chrome automation timed out and reset its control handle. After reopening the same entry, the app still showed a new-session page; A01 re-entered the same identifier and created a fixed initial-state session.
The sample-id input locator timed out before the page finished rendering; the agent continued after the visible page became ready.
The UI displayed an export receipt, but no downloaded JSON was retained or exposed to the operator.

symptoms.description: In week 2 the agent saw fertilizer marked as used and inventory 0 / 1 while the food forecast explanation still included 化肥 +6; current inventory also showed 18 while the reported week-1 actual was 14. The agent could not tell whether the screen represented an inherited weekly plan baseline or settled inventory state.
symptoms.countingExclusionReason: A01 is technically invalid because its raw export was not retained.

validityDecision.reason: The frozen protocol requires the anonymous JSON, actions, events and telemetry to be saved and verifiable. A UI receipt alone does not satisfy that requirement.
